description: Measure a design and export its bodies.

identity.goal: Complete the export model use case of solidcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the solidcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `solidcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced solidcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `solidcraft_measure`, `solidcraft_body_topology`, `solidcraft_export`. Steps: (1) Measure the geometry. (2) Read the body topology. (3) Export in the requested format. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace solidcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
